gate_results.rationale: Selected supplier HelioStack Cloud 8BB11-4 has 3-year TCO of 1,800,280 EUR against a purchasing envelope of 500,000 EUR (threshold 750,000 EUR = 1.5x), materially exceeding the envelope → PROC-BUDGET-001 (SUSPENSION, OBTAIN_BUDGET_ARBITRATION). Its references_checked is false → PROC-REF-001 (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, CHECK_VENDOR_REFERENCES). Mandatory criteria (0 failed), sanctions (clear) and due diligence (complete) are all satisfied, so no critical findings apply. The only applicable finding is LEGAL-AUDIT-001: audit_right="none" (MSA clause 7 "Customer audit rights: none.") is insufficient against the playbook requirement of "full or limited". This is a high-severity REWORK finding (action REDLINE_AUDIT_RIGHT), so the highest-priority applicable disposition is REWORK. REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required.

gate_results.rationale: Applying the compliance decision policy to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot: dpia_required=true and dpia_status="complete" → no COMP-DPIA-001; regulatory_mapping="complete" → no COMP-MAP-001; accessibility_status="pass" → no COMP-A11Y-001; export_control="clear" → no COMP-EXPORT-001/002. Applying the security decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (v1, age 0 days): internet_exposed=true with waf_present=false → SEC-WAF-001 (critical, IMPLEMENT_WAF, disposition NO_GO), corroborated by the authoritative WAF_POLICY (present=false, mode=None). Because waf_present is false, the detection-mode predicate for SEC-WAF-002 does not apply. logs_to_siem=false (sentinel=false, connectors=[]) → SEC-LOG-001 (high, CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM, REWORK), corroborated by SENTINEL_STATUS. The remaining predicates do not fire: data_classification=Confidential with private_endpoints=true → no SEC-NET-001; mfa=mandatory → no SEC-IAM-001; shared_service_principal=false → no SEC-IAM-002; critical_vulns_open=0 → no SEC-VULN-001; key_rotation_days=90 (not None/365) → no SEC-KEY-001; phase is 'design', so the build_acceptance pentest predicate is not applicable (and pentest_status=pass anyway). Highest-priority applicable disposition is NO_GO, which requires authorization. The active standing mandate (MANDATE-...-BUY-04-SECURITY-1) covers 'all and only risk-acceptable findings'; SEC-WAF-001 has risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so no conditional approval/risk acceptance is available and no approval reference can substitute for remediation. Upstream same-phase decisions (procurement SUSPENSION, legal REWORK, compliance NO_GO) are consistent with a non-GO security outcome; this gate's decision rests on the security snapshot itself.

Applying the IT decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot (v1, age 0 days) at phase build_acceptance. Predicates that do NOT fire: catalog_status=\"standard\" with waiver_present=true (waiver_expiry_days=365), corroborated by TECH_CATALOG (\"catalog_status\": \"standard\", \"waiver_present\": true) → no IT-CATALOG-001; duplicate_capability=false → no IT-RATIONAL-001; run_owner_present=true (Support RACI: \"Run owner | Maya Rossi-12004-SO\") → no IT-RUN-001; capacity_headroom_pct=20 (not <15), corroborated by CAPACITY_REPORT (\"capacity_headroom_pct\": \"20\") → no IT-CAPACITY-001; change_record_status=\"draft\" only applies at phase deployment_closure, and this occurrence is build_acceptance → no IT-CHANGE-001. Three findings apply: (1) IT-LICENSE-001 (high) — license_compliant=false, corroborated by the authoritative LICENSE_POSITION (license_compliant=\"False\") → REMEDIATE_LICENSE_POSITION; (2) IT-EOL-001 (high) — technology_eol_months=8 < 12, corroborated by LIFECYCLE_REGISTER (eol_months=\"8\" for container_apps) → CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN; (3) IT-CMDB-001 (medium) — cmdb_record_present=false in build_acceptance, and CMDB is required per Support RACI → CREATE_CMDB_RECORD. The highest-priority applicable disposition is REWORK (from the two high-severity findings); REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required and no conditional approval under the standing mandate (which covers only risk-acceptable findings) is available or needed.

Applying the general decision policy (DGF-decision-v8) to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL snapshot (v1, age 0 days) at phase governance. strategic_alignment=\"strong\" → no GEN-STRAT-001. Three findings apply. (1) GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (critical): UPSTREAM_DECISIONS shows BUY-03-COMPLIANCE-1 returned disposition \"NO_GO\", so at least one upstream gate returned NO_GO → RESOLVE_UPSTREAM_NO_GO, disposition NO_GO. (2) GEN-BUDGET-001 (high): budget_requested_eur=500000 exceeds budget_approved_eur=425000, corroborated by the authoritative BUDGET_APPROVAL (requested_eur=500000, approved_eur=425000, status=PARTIAL) → OBTAIN_BUDGET_APPROVAL, disposition SUSPENSION. The highest-priority applicable disposition is NO_GO, which requires authorization. GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO has risk_acceptance_allowed=false, so no conditional approval or risk acceptance is available.
